about: Answer key for the keyed pseudo-element pages pseudo-v1 (queue #103, W13b, hypothesis H9 in ~/design-lab/homepage-workflow/HYPOTHESES.md). Written from the pages' source and sealed (~/design-lab/seals/pseudo-v1.json, pseudo-v1.sha256) before the converter change. Each ::before/::after is named by its host's id and pseudo. 'drawn' means the converter draws it in the Penpot file (text kinds as live text holding exactly 'text'; shape kinds as a filled or stroked layer) and verify's pseudo check reads it there. 'none' means no visible paint: it must not be drawn and not be counted. 'not-drawn' means visible paint the converter can't draw: it must file pseudo-element-not-drawn and make the pseudo check fail. A mismatch is explained in ~/design-lab/homepage-workflow/wave2/W13b-REPORT.md (page wrong or converter wrong), never fixed by editing this key to match a converter.

kinds.text: content holds visible text and the pseudo has no box paint
kinds.box: content holds visible text and the pseudo also paints a box (background, border or shadow)
kinds.shape: empty content, the pseudo paints a box only

items.note: inline tick before an item, as Signalbox's .tier li::before
flex item in an inline-flex button
8 px round status dot, empty content, as Signalbox's span.state::before
the same dot in the slow colour, as span.state.slow::before
border-only rule, no background (today's detector doesn't even see it)
attr(); leading space may collapse in the drawn text, the word must be there
content: none, even though it declares a size and a background

today: Before the change (converter at temper-ai master fecacf06), expected: index.html files pseudo-element-ignored for P1a-P1c, P2, P3, P4a, P4b, P7, P8, P9, P10 (11 per width; P5 and P6 are border-only and not even seen), draws none of them, and its converter verify passes. That is the gap.
pixels: Turning pseudo-elements into elements must not change the page's own browser pixels: screenshot before vs after, each width, at most 0.01 % of pixels differ.
